unit_and_count_caution: Paper-level candidate inventory below contains only relevant bibliographic candidates deliberately screened after the returned web results were inspected. It is not the number of raw web URLs, search-engine total hits, original manuscript screening pool, or all papers contained in source reference lists. Duplicate web pages are merged by DOI/title. Queries were batched; result attribution to individual queries is recorded only for intended seed queries, not inferred ranks.
deduplication_rule: Same DOI or title/author identity merged across publisher, author PDF, arXiv, institutional and aggregator pages; distinct theory and empirical companion papers remain separate.
inclusion_rule: Direct primary evidence for interaction design, empirical explanation use/effects, or understanding/strategic behavior under mechanism implementations/descriptions; include theory only as an explicitly identified conceptual link.
exclusion_rule: Unrelated search noise and secondary mirrors excluded as sources; additional related records outside the focused explanation/description addition not taken forward; no quality verdict inferred from nonselection.

included.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
included.read_level: primary full-text PDF: abstract, Table 1, evaluation and discussion
included.supported_claim: Practitioner evaluations support inspection-oriented guidance about capabilities, fallibility, correction, feedback and adaptation; they do not estimate a universal effect on decisions.
included.limits: Design-guideline applicability; not a strategic-interaction experiment.
included.screening_reason: Direct evidence about explanation use, comprehension, or strategic reporting required by R2-6 and AE-2; theory included only to distinguish rule properties from observed behavior.

included.title: Interpreting Interpretability: Understanding Data Scientists' Use of Interpretability Tools for Machine Learning
included.read_level: primary author full-text PDF: methods, findings and limitations
included.supported_claim: Contextual inquiry and survey of GAM/SHAP use identify misunderstanding, over-trust and misuse despite some successful issue discovery.
included.limits: Tabular task; realism and longitudinal generalization remain uncertain.
included.screening_reason: Direct evidence about explanation use, comprehension, or strategic reporting required by R2-6 and AE-2; theory included only to distinguish rule properties from observed behavior.

included.title: Manipulating and Measuring Model Interpretability
included.read_level: primary author full-text PDF: experimental setup, four experiments and limitations
included.supported_claim: Transparency and feature count affect simulation; better simulation does not establish better beneficial reliance, and clear models hamper error correction in some experiments.
included.limits: Laypeople, linear regression, real-estate valuation; error-correction result differs in experiment 3.
included.screening_reason: Direct evidence about explanation use, comprehension, or strategic reporting required by R2-6 and AE-2; theory included only to distinguish rule properties from observed behavior.

included.read_level: primary full-text HTML: tasks, explanation conditions, results and limitations
included.supported_claim: Tested explanations increase recommendation acceptance without additional complementary-accuracy gains in text classification/question-answering studies.
included.limits: Crowdsourced tasks, limited explanation formats and expertise coverage; not a universal no-benefit result.
included.screening_reason: Direct evidence about explanation use, comprehension, or strategic reporting required by R2-6 and AE-2; theory included only to distinguish rule properties from observed behavior.
